{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "notifications": [
    {
      "id": "16f7d877-49e3-41c3-9ca6-f951d3d8ba80",
      "title": "The Channels SDK is live, plus CopilotKit for Angular!",
      "body": "## Now live: the Channels SDK

The **Channels SDK** lets you build native, stateful experiences for any agent across Slack, Microsoft Teams, and more — without the production headaches. Slack and Teams are generally available today, with Discord and WhatsApp coming soon.

With the Channels SDK, you can:

- **Write once, render native everywhere** — author shared Channels JSX a single time and it renders as native Block Kit in Slack and Adaptive Cards in Microsoft Teams, so one agent architecture expands to new platforms without a rebuild
- **Act in context** — investigate an issue, call a tool, or move work forward with the conversation still in view
- **Make approvals native** — route decisions through Block Kit and Adaptive Cards instead of sending people off to another dashboard

Works with LangGraph, CrewAI, Microsoft Agent Framework, or any custom AG-UI agent.

[Try a live agent in our Community Slack →](https://go.copilotkit.ai/TryChannels)

[Read the Channels SDK launch post →](https://go.copilotkit.ai/Blog/ChannelsSDK)

---

## New: CopilotKit for Angular

Bring any AG-UI agent into your Angular app with **`@copilotkit/angular`**, the Angular bindings for CopilotKit — built on native Angular patterns and signals.

CopilotKit for Angular includes:

- **Drop-in chat UI** — add `<copilot-chat />` with compose, suggestions, and attachments already wired up
- **Generative UI and A2UI** — agent-generated component trees render directly in the chat stream through registered tools
- **Shared agent state** — expose trusted Angular signals to the agent with `injectAgentStore()` and register narrow frontend mutations

[Explore the Angular resources →](https://go.copilotkit.ai/angular-resources-page)

[Open the Angular docs →](https://go.copilotkit.ai/angular-docs)

---

## Also new

CopilotKit v1.67 also includes:

- A **reorganized Web Inspector** — navigation is now grouped into Threads, Agents, and Learning, and the Threads sidebar gains a usage footer
- A **bounded in-memory agent runner**, so the default runner no longer grows until the process runs out of memory
- **`fullHeightChildren` on `CopilotSidebar`**, an opt-in prop that lets sidebar content fill the viewport

[Read the v1.67 release notes →](https://go.copilotkit.ai/copilotkit-release-notes)",
      "publishedAt": "2026-08-13T13:00:00.000Z",
      "audiences": [
        {}
      ],
      "priority": "Normal"
    },
    {
      "id": "2e930b26-c970-484a-b340-a2cb28f20224",
      "title": "AG-UI 1.0 is here, plus OpenBot and OpenMuse!",
      "body": "## AG-UI 1.0 is here

AG-UI, the protocol that connects agents to user-facing apps, has reached **1.0**. The spec is also published as a JSON Schema, and every SDK is generated from it, so TypeScript, Python, and .NET all speak exactly the same protocol.

What's new in 1.0:

- **Subagents**: new events show which agent did what when work is delegated, so your UI can give each subagent its own card while it works
- **Human-in-the-loop interrupts**: a run can pause to ask the user something, and the next run picks up right where it left off
- **Multimodal tool results**: tools can return images, audio, video, and documents, not just text
- **Metadata** for sending custom data from your agent to the frontend
- **Token usage** on every run, so you can show what each run cost, subagents included
- **Reasoning and activity events** for "Thinking..." panels and live progress widgets
- **Backwards compatible**: your existing agents and apps keep working

[Read the developer’s guide to AG-UI →](https://go.copilotkit.ai/dev-guide-to-ag-ui)

[Open the AG-UI docs →](https://docs.ag-ui.com)

---

## New: OpenBot

**Open-source AI coworkers your company can actually own.** Each coworker gets a computer of its own: a real browser, its own files, and only the tools you grant. Every action is decided before it happens and recorded after.

Bring any AG-UI agent, watch it work on its own screen, and take the wheel when it reaches something it shouldn't do alone.

[Explore OpenBot →](https://go.copilotkit.ai/openbot)

[Star it on GitHub →](https://github.com/CopilotKit/OpenBot)

---

## New: OpenMuse

**A personal agent with a browser, terminal, files, and work that keeps going.** Ask for an outcome, follow the plan, review its actions, and come back to the result.

Built with CopilotKit React Native, so it runs on iOS, Android, and the web from one codebase. Clone it and make it yours.

[Explore OpenMuse →](https://go.copilotkit.ai/openmuse)

[Star it on GitHub →](https://github.com/CopilotKit/openmuse)

---

## Also new

Recent CopilotKit releases (v1.69 to v1.75) also include:

- A **redesigned Inspector** with a new Home view, runtime health at a glance, and an isolated **agent Playground** where you can fork a saved Thread without touching the original
- **`transformMessages` on `CopilotChatMessageView`** to reshape messages before they render
- **More resilient SSE streaming**, including reconnects that keep their place

[Read the release notes →](https://go.copilotkit.ai/copilotkit-release-notes)",

    }
  ]
